configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Portable base preset. Qt6 and VTK are machine-specific: provide their install prefixes via the CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH environment variable, or create a CMakeUserPresets.json (git-ignored) that inherits this preset and sets cacheVariables.CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH. Example: export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/path/to/Qt/6.x/macos:/path/to/VTK-9.x
